domains.use: Create the aircraft hull as a validated mesh.cube document and render its real authored vertex/face geometry in the flight scene.

gameOwned.simulation: Deterministic flight, glide lift, wind, fuel, touchdown, rescue, delivery, hull damage, and shift clock; independent of rendering and input.
gameOwned.movementAndCollision: Game-owned side-view arcade flight model with speed-sensitive rooftop touchdown; no external physics provider.
gameOwned.input: Keyboard and touch controls map to horizontal thrust, powered climb, descent, and held rescue.
gameOwned.rendering: Canvas 2D city, rooftop landmarks, aircraft, wind, route board, and flight HUD.
